meta_description:
1,712 likes, 54 comments - cosmoindia on October 30, 2026: "Kubbra Sait (@kubbrasait) was well into her 20s when she realised that living authentically was how she wanted to live. This hasn’t changed in the years since, as she’s moved cities (Bengaluru to Dubai and now Mumbai) and changed professions (marketing to entertainment). On an unseasonably hot October evening when we chatted online, she’s at the members-only section of Mumbai’s Soho House. Dressed in activewear, with not a lick of makeup, she is glowing—but she’s something more, something strong. Even with the publicity machinery around her, she is a unique presence.

Read her full interview at the link in bio!

Editor: Snigdha Ahuja (@snigdha.ahuja)
Interview: Karishma Upadhyay (@karishmaupadhyay)
Photographer: Sushant Chhabria (@sushantchhabria)
Stylist: Zoha Castelino (@zohacastelino)
Make-up Artist: Arleen Gonsalves (@arleen_gonsalves)
Hair Artist: Ishitaa Pahuja (@eetle.beetle)
Editorial Coordinator: Shalini Kanojia (@shalinikanojia)
Assistant Stylist: Aayushi Vaidya (@runwayrecess)
Artist PR Agency: Idhyah Media (@idhyahmedia)

On Kubbra Sait: Dress, Diesel (@diesel); earrings, Tribe Amrapali (@tribebyamrapali); hand cuff, NOYA (@noya.dubai); heels, Kubbra’s own
